newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen drifting lower, may test 980.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen drifting lower, may test 980.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures are expected to drift lower after failing to make much headway on the upside, with July lining up for a pullback to test the key 980 stg support.
Traders called the market to open unchanged.
Susan Rigg, a technical analyst at Chart Analysis, said the chart outlook for cocoa was not looking too bright.
"It has gone up to hold at the higher level but it keeps getting stuck at the lateral trading," she said.
"At the moment, it is just short of the 1,040 stg area," she said. If it goes through the resistance level, the market will extend the rise to 1,055.
Failing that, there was a chance that the market would come back to the 980 area. "Every time it goes to a high level, it will come back to revisit the support level."
